# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Runtime and platform fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves image and text processing while strengthening Android, Linux, and WebAssembly support. It fixes native string and stream lifetime issues, reduces allocations in pixel and shaping paths, and refreshes platform packaging.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Native string data is copied safely** — FromCString now avoids reading past its native buffer and writes directly into SKData. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Front-buffered streams retain their data** — Keeps the front buffer alive for the lifetime required by stream consumers. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Synchronizes Android texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for steadier presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Image and text processing allocate less** — Optimizes managed pixel copies and avoids temporary native and UTF-32 encoding buffers when processing image data and HarfBuzz feature strings. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Linux resolves bundled HarfBuzz functions locally** — Binds HarfBuzz functions from the bundled native library on Linux rather than relying on external symbol resolution. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **WebAssembly includes WebGPU implementation code** — Ships emdawnwebgpu's WebGPU implementation inside the WebAssembly native archive. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Apple platform deployment minimums updated** — Raises the supported deployment minimums for Apple platform targets. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
